overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee showed a reasonable basis for continuing to withhold minutes and documents from 2022 bargaining executive sessions, though it reminded the committee that withholding cannot last indefinitely and must be reviewed periodically.

allegations.summary: Alleged the committee keeps withholding minutes and documents from 2022 bargaining executive sessions after disclosure would no longer defeat their purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee has made a sufficient showing to justify its continued nondisclosure of the minutes of and documents used during the 2022 executive sessions.
